sequential_dependency.intermediate: The ordered compatible-glyph list, including each glyph's reading-order index, normalized mask, and input-derived block scale.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Locate the largest rectangular frame, infer the sparse evidence's logical blocks under each candidate scale, and filter the reading-ordered top glyphs to the ordered list compatible with every evidence point.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Use candidate_choice to select the first or last element of that compatible list, then expand the selected mask at its scale inside the preserved frame.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The selected mask and scale are members of A's input-dependent compatible list; B cannot determine which top glyph to expand from position alone. In this witness the global last glyph is incompatible, so skipping A changes the final output.
